entries.description: An inactive community in Michigan that owns land and welcomes new members, including non-lesbian women and children.
entries.raw_text: ARADIA INC MARIE CURIE TASK FORCE PO Box 7516, Grand Rapids, MI 49507. We are interested in, among other things, womyn's land. As individuals and severals we own land. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women (womyn born only), dogs sometimes. We are: 95% lesbians, 5% nonlesbians, inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as they state 'As individuals and severals we own land' and 'inactive group with hopes to revive'. Accepted groups include Lesbian women (inferred from questionnaire directory context), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children').

entries.description: An organization in New Mexico offering backpacking experiences to give women closer contact with nature.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S WILDERNESS EXPERIENCE/Jeanie Mudd, PO Box 4681, Santa Fe, NM 87502 (505)983-1175. An organization designed for women so that they might have closer contact with the land. WWE wants to show women a way to be with nature, that is not intimidating nor fearful, yet physically challenging. It is a backpacking experience.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space based on offering backpacking experiences and outdoor education ('An organization designed for women so that they might have closer contact with the land'). Accepted group Lesbian women inferred from directory context.

entries.description: A cultural and writing project based in Vermont compiling stories of lesbian land.
entries.raw_text: LESBIANS ON LAND Joyce Cheney, 78 Monroe St, Burlington, VT 05401. I'm compiling stories of lesbian land. Format: Chapters about several lesbian lands across the US, each chapter with photos, drawings, and transcriptions of taped interviews. I'm looking for a woman or women from some part of the herstory of each women's land, who will collect stories of that land. Process is participant controlled: You'll decide whether to use false or real names and locations, and what stories to include. They're your stories! Please write!
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land as a single individual (Joyce Cheney) is compiling stories rather than operating a community. Focuses includes Archives/cultural work for compiling history and stories. Accepted group Lesbian women inferred from directory context.

entries.description: A large community in Virginia with 400 acres, four resident lesbians, 65 non-lesbian members, welcoming women and men, with a strict no-drugs policy.
entries.raw_text: OAKYNWOMYN Twin Oaks Community, Louisa, VA 23093. We are a large community of women and men looking for more lesbians and wimmyn-oriented-wimmyn. By our behavior we strive to eliminate the attitudes and results of sexism, heterosexism, racism, ageism and competition. Bring no pets. NO DRUGS! We welcome: new members/residents, children (maybe), lesbians, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 65 nonlesbians, 400 acres, housing/permanent structures (residences, shops, garage, etc), plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND group per editor's note ('not women's land groups, but they do welcome lesbians as visitors or members'). Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as they describe themselves as 'a large community of women and men'. Acreage is 400. Num_residents is 4 ('4 lesbians' living on the land). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Gay men and Non-gay men ('males'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free due to 'NO DRUGS!'.

entries.description: A farm in Tennessee with 7 acres, promoting pacifist musical craftspeople and simple living, welcoming all genders and children, with a no-hard-drugs policy.
entries.raw_text: FAR AWAY FARM Rt 7 Box 279, Sparta, TN 38583 (615)277-3854. Pacifist musical craftspeople in simple lifestyle promoting spiritual power and androgynous philosophy. Short visits welcome with advance notice. No TV. Pets under strict supervision only. No hard drugs, others with our knowledge. We welcome: children, lesbians, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have: 7 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: NOT WOMEN'S LAND group per editor's note. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as an agricultural and lifestyle collective. Acreage is 7. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (directory context), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('children'), Gay men and Non-gay men ('males'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('No hard drugs'); Archives/cultural work ('musical craftspeople').
